explainer.foot: Opinion · figures from dated public trackers · not financial advice

post.name: HEADBOY 🦇🔊
paras: Airdrops have peaked, and even launching a token for crypto startups doesn’t seem right.
This year recorded the lowest number of airdrops received by users, the lowest number of TGEs, and the highest number of projects shutting down.

say: I keep reading posts saying airdrops have peaked.

beats.title: Year by year

hl.name: Hyperliquid
hl.src: Hyper Foundation via The Block · Nov 2024

say.say: In twenty twenty-four, airdrops paid out around fifteen billion dollars.
say.show: In 2024, airdrops paid out around $15 billion.

say.say: Hyperliquid alone gave thirty-one percent of its supply to users. No V C allocation.
say.show: Hyperliquid alone gave 31% of its supply to users. No VC allocation.

say.say: In twenty twenty-five, the top five airdrops did about four and a half billion, at peak.
say.show: In 2025, the top five airdrops did about $4.5 billion, at peak.

say.say: This year, one tracker counted fifty-one big airdrops on four chains. Around eight hundred and nine million.
say.show: This year, one tracker counted 51 big airdrops on four chains. Around $809 million.

say: So yes, it dropped. A lot.

beats.title: The other side

coins.label: new coins on Pump.fun on 26 Oct

say: But look at the other side.

say.say: Pump dot fun launches around forty-six thousand coins every single day.
say.show: Pump.fun launches around 46,000 coins every single day.

say.say: Pump has made over one point three billion in revenue, and coin creators have taken over six hundred and fifty million in fees.
say.show: Pump has made over $1.3 billion in revenue, and coin creators have taken over $650 million in fees.

say.say: Axiom users have paid about seven hundred and eighty-two million in fees.
say.show: Axiom users have paid about $782 million in fees.

a.name: Pump.fun on X
a.quote: “$PUMP is launching through an Initial Coin Offering on Saturday, July 12th. airdrop coming soon.”

b.name: Polymarket CMO Matthew Modabber
b.quote: “There will be a token, there will be an airdrop.”
b.note: Help page, Jun 2026: “Polymarket has not announced plans for any airdrop.”

say.say: In July twenty twenty-five, Pump dot fun said: airdrop coming soon.
say.show: In July 2025, Pump.fun said: “airdrop coming soon.”

say.say: They sold their token in a six hundred million dollar I C O instead.
say.show: They sold their token in a $600 million ICO instead.

say.say: Four hundred and seventy-five days later, still no airdrop.
Polymarket's C M O said: there will be a token, there will be an airdrop.
say.show: Polymarket's CMO said: “There will be a token, there will be an airdrop.”

say: That was October last year. And they started charging fees this year.

beats.title: The money is there
say: In my opinion, it's the same money that would have been airdrops in previous cycles.
We just have devs and builders who have become greedy and extractive.

beats.title: It went back in
say: If the money being extracted from crypto was invested back into the space, we'd be in a better place.
And no, airdrops have not peaked, because that's the core ethos of crypto.
